methodology.area: Spherical polygon area from Census longitude/latitude geometry; exterior area minus holes.
methodology.perimeter: Haversine length of every exterior and interior boundary ring at Census detailed resolution.
methodology.polsbyPopper: 4*pi*area/perimeter^2. Values approach 1 for a circle but depend on boundary resolution and coastlines.
methodology.convexHullRatio: District area divided by a local Lambert azimuthal equal-area convex hull area.
methodology.resolutionStability: Stable requires detailed-vs-1:500,000 relative differences of at most 20% for Polsby-Popper and 10% for convex-hull ratio.
methodology.percentile: Relative rank within the same geography type nationwide; it is not a gerrymandering, intent, legality, or representation score.

resultRelationship.reason: The repository does not yet contain a nationwide certified, same-plan-vintage district result set. Compactness is not joined to election outcomes across mismatched plans or geography.
